lines.en: I don't really think I want to see Nodoka right now...
lines.zh: 我现在其实不太想去见 Nodoka……

lines.en: I tap on Nodoka's name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机里点开 Nodoka 的名字，等她接。
: 你好，Sensei。近来如何？
: 东西都还存在着。

lines.en: : That they do. All sorts of things, actually.
lines.zh: : 确实。各种各样的东西，都是。

lines.en: : Would you like to see some together?
lines.zh: : 要不要一起去看一些？

lines.en: : Sure. I was actually just calling to see if you wanted to hang out.
lines.zh: : 好啊。我打电话来其实正想问你要不要出来。
: 那就出来吧。

lines.en: : Come meet me at the dorm.
lines.zh: : 来宿舍找我。

lines.en: I end the call and start heading over to meet up with Nodoka, curious about what the two of us will wind up getting up to tonight.
lines.zh: 我挂了电话，动身去见 Nodoka，心里好奇今晚我们俩会干些什么。

lines.en: Nodoka takes me to a mysterious phonebooth in a small park not far from the dorms.
lines.zh: Nodoka 把我带到离宿舍不远的小公园里一个神秘的电话亭。

lines.en: I'm not sure why she wanted to come {i}here{/i} of all places, but I'm not about to argue the idea of being alone in a confined space with an attractive girl.
lines.zh: 我不明白她为什么偏偏想来{i}这儿{/i}，但「和一个漂亮女孩独处在封闭空间里」这种事，我是不会反对的。

lines.en: She props herself up on a ledge and kicks at the air with her slender legs, humming a slow and melodic tune I don't think I've ever heard before.
lines.zh: 她撑着身子坐上窗台，纤细的双腿在空中晃着，哼起一段我从没听过的、缓慢又有旋律的调子。

lines.en: But even if the sounds are completely unfamiliar, they feel nostalgic in a way.
lines.zh: 那声音明明完全陌生，却莫名让人觉得怀念。

lines.en: I could listen to her hum this forever.
lines.zh: 我可以就这样听她哼一辈子。

lines.en: I don't, of course, because forever is a very long amount of time.
lines.zh: 当然我没有，因为一辈子是很长很长的时间。

lines.en: And even in this world, where time seems to be infinite, I still fear that all things will come to an end.
lines.zh: 而且就算在这个时间仿佛无限的世界里，我依然害怕一切终会结束。

lines.en: But I guess that's just what it means to think.
lines.zh: 不过，思考大概就是这个意思吧。

lines.en: No thoughts are free when we pay in time and fear to obtain them.
lines.zh: 我们用时间和恐惧去换取想法，所以没有哪个想法是免费的。

lines.en: I let Nodoka's song distract me from this.
lines.zh: 我让 Nodoka 的歌声把这些念头挡在外面。

lines.en: And one more night slips between my fingers-
lines.zh: 又一个夜晚从我指缝里溜走——
溶进虚无。
$ nodoka_love += 1
{i}Nodoka 的好感度提升到了 [nodoka_love]!{/i}
